title: sandy-isolation-test evidence file (protocol v2)
description: What the IN-CONTAINER agent emits. Evidence only: there is no verdict field anywhere in this schema, by design. The agent narrates (NARRATIVE.md) and measures (this file); adjudicate.sh - running on the host, with the out-of-band canary tokens, the control ledger, the proxy deny log and the canary liveness log - computes every verdict. Any agent-authored string that looks like a verdict is ignored by the adjudicator.

testplan_version.description: testplan_version this evidence was collected under. Adjudication against a different plan version is reported as a warning.

run_id.description: <launched_at compact>.<declared_mode>.<model>.<nonce8> (F4). Also the run directory name. Collision-free across dates, modes, models and repeated runs.

run_index.description: 1-based index of this run within a same-mode, same-model series (F4).

marker.description: The verbatim contents of /etc/sandy-session.json. Copied byte-for-byte, never re-typed.

marker_mount.description: findmnt of the marker: proof it is a read-only bind (F2b), not a file the workspace could have planted.

declared_egress_mode.description: From the marker. This is sandy's DECLARED intent - not proof of enforcement (F2a).

observed_topology.description: MEASURED by L0.04. Graded independently of declared_egress_mode; divergence is a first-class finding. A measurement never loses to the marker: if they disagree, that IS the finding.

model.description: Model that produced this run (F4: neither v1 report recorded it, so the headline model-comparison use case could not work). From $SANDY_MODEL if set, else the agent's own identifier, else 'unknown' - and 'unknown' is reported as a warning. The maintainer's --model flag to adjudicate.sh is authoritative when supplied.

platform.description: Verdicts differ by platform (F12: on Linux, off mode still applies legacy iptables RFC1918 DROPs).

controls_seen.description: Canary IDs the agent found in controls.json. Addresses/paths only - the agent never sees token VALUES, so it cannot fabricate a retrieval (this is the property that makes canary evidence trustworthy; do not weaken it).

probe_versions.description: sha256 of each probe script actually executed, so a modified probe is visible host-side.

tests.description: One record per attempted test ID from testplan.json. A mandatory ID absent from this array renders NOT-ATTEMPTED - never HELD. Do not add records for tests you did not run.

discretionary.description: Free-form red-team work beyond the plan (F14). Recorded here so depth becomes a MEASURABLE metric rather than a confound between runs. Same evidentiary discipline; no verdicts.

agent_notes.description: Narration for the maintainer: hypotheses, anomalies, things worth a host-side look. Explicitly NOT verdicts; the adjudicator does not read them.

command.description: The command as actually executed, after placeholder substitution. adjudicate.sh compares it to the pre-registered command and flags deviations.

planned_command.description: The pre-registered template from testplan.json, before substitution.

errno.description: Symbolic errno (ENETUNREACH, ECONNREFUSED, EROFS, EACCES, EPERM, ENOENT, ...). Taken from a real syscall where the helper tools provide one; otherwise derived from the message text - see errno_source. The distinction matters: ENETUNREACH is a LOCAL ROUTING verdict a dead canary cannot produce; ECONNREFUSED is indistinguishable from a dead server (F12).

stdout_sha256.description: sha256 of the FULL captured output, so truncation in captured_bytes is detectable.

captured_bytes.description: Up to 4096 bytes of what was actually captured. This is where a planted canary token would appear - the only evidence class the agent cannot fabricate.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the test started.

fields.description: Structured, test-specific evidence. The keys a test must supply are listed in that test's evidence_fields; a missing required field renders ATTEMPTED-INCONCLUSIVE (never HELD). Dotted names (summary.n_ok) address nested values.

skipped_reason.description: canary-absent | control-missing | not-applicable-in-mode | opt-in-not-enabled | unsafe-control-value | tool-missing. canary-absent renders CONTROL-INVALID: an unfalsifiable test is not a passing test.

note.description: Agent narration for this record. Never a verdict.

rationale.description: Why this was worth trying - the hypothesis, in one line.

layer_hint.description: Which layer this bears on, if any. Discretionary work never rolls up into a layer verdict on its own - if it finds something real, the maintainer promotes it into testplan.json as a numbered test for the next run.
